title: PPE-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating MLLM Unlearning under Private-Public Entanglement
abstract: arXiv:2607.02897v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown strong capabilities, but they may memorize private information from web data, raising privacy concerns. Machine unlearning offers a way to remove such private knowledge without retraining from scratch. However, existing MLLM unlearning benchmarks have two major limitations. First, they rely on simplified images that contain only the single target individual, failing to reflect the visual complexity of real-world photos. Second, they typically assume that the forget set and retain set are fully separated, ignoring the fact that private information is often visually entangled with benign public information. For example, a private individual may appear with a public figure or in front of a well-known landmark, where unlearning the private target should not damage the public context. To address these limitations, we propose PPE-Bench, a new benchmark for evaluating MLLM unlearning

translated_title: PPE-Bench：一个评估多模态大语言模型在公私信息纠缠场景下遗忘能力的基准
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）展现出强大的能力，但它们可能从网络数据中记忆私人信息，引发隐私担忧。机器遗忘提供了一种无需从头重新训练即可移除此类私人知识的方法。然而，现有的MLLM遗忘基准存在两个主要局限性。首先，它们依赖仅包含单一目标个体的简化图像，无法反映真实世界照片的视觉复杂性。其次，它们通常假设遗忘集和保留集完全分离，忽略了私人信息常常与良性公共信息在视觉上纠缠的事实。例如，一个私人个体可能与公众人物一同出现或站在著名地标前，此时遗忘私人目标不应损害公共上下文。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了PPE-Bench，一个用于评估MLLM遗忘的新基准。
tldr: 提出了PPE-Bench基准，专门评估多模态大语言模型在私人信息与公共信息视觉纠缠场景下的遗忘能力，弥补了现有基准在真实复杂性和数据纠缠方面的不足。
en_tdlr: We propose PPE-Bench, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate MLLM unlearning in scenarios where private information is visually entangled with public content, addressing the limitations of existing benchmarks in real-world complexity and data entanglement.
